summary: Launch One Acquisition Corp. filed an 8-K to postpone its extraordinary general meeting from July 7 to July 10, 2026, to vote on extending its business combination deadline from July 15, 2026 to January 15, 2027. The extension amendment proposal is a routine SPAC procedural step, not an event-driven special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, or activist campaign is involved. The filing is a routine schedule change with no financial terms or strategic shift.
